meaning: sharp word, sharp (cutting) word, taunt, gibe

elsewhere.note: You will become an astonishment, a proverb, and a byword among all the peoples where Yahweh will lead you away.
then I will cut off Israel out of the land which I have given them; and I will cast this house, which I have made holy for my name, out of my sight; and Israel…
then I will pluck them up by the roots out of my land which I have given them; and this house, which I have made holy for my name, I will cast out of my sight…
I will even give them up to be tossed back and forth among all the kingdoms of the earth for evil; to be a reproach and a proverb, a taunt and a curse, in all…
